en: sam — first beat of the cycle

occurrences.subsection_title: Here Begins the Section on Performance
occurrences.snippet: In nibaddha gāna (bound singing) the sam (first beat of the cycle) is of great importance, so we cannot go further without understanding the definition of sam.

occurrences.subsection_title: Here Begins the Section on Performance
occurrences.snippet: Where the main part of the rāga is placed at the start of the tāla, and a long syllable meets it right there, that meeting is called sam.
